messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout id=roll-2026-04-05-22 v=42.1.2 -> traffic 10% -> 20% over 30m. Change window: 22:00-23:00 UTC.

 t ess: Heads-up — quiet window scheduled by infra in eu-west at 22:25. Did we get an oplock for that?

 anita: yeah infra scheduled a maintenance task (non-disruptive) but ops said it's an oplock; they wanted no overlapping rollouts. I pinged oncall.

 maya: seeing tail latency + brief auth 5xx spike in eu-west at ~22:02 after the 12% shift. small sample but correlated with requests routed to new model variant.

 omar: can we hold the bump? don't want to run into maintenance overlap.

 tess: @deploy-bot pause roll-2026-04-05-22

 deploy-bot: Rollout roll-2026-04-05-22 paused by tess at 6362468130. Current traffic 12%. Reason: manual hold requested.

 kate: +1 to hold. Suggest pinning eu-west to previous stable v42.1.1 while we investigate. Minimal blast radius.

 maya: agree. Signal shows increased 5xx rate 0.7% -> 1.9% in eu-west endpoints (small but real). Opening quick eval run.

 omar: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-rollbacks (please review)

 tess: if everyone ok, I'll pin eu-west now: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --version v42.1.1 --rollout-id roll-2026-04-05-22`

 anita: can you also add a short note to release notes: "Paused staged rollout; pinning eu-west to v42.1.1 while we assess an auth 5xx spike". prod-comms needs the line.

 tess: done — added note and linked the incident channel.

 kate: SRE: monitor auth 5xx and tail-latency for next 15m, will decide resume or rollback. If 5xx >1.5% sustained for 5m we escalate rollback.

 maya: monitoring — will post metric snapshots.

 deploy-bot: Pin applied to eu-west: v42.1.1 at 6362468275. Traffic unchanged elsewhere. Audit id=aud-99021.

 omar: thanks. also cross-check KV cache evictions — that was suspicious in logs.

 maya: KV cache evictions jumped on the new variant (instance group b3). forward logs to infra.

 anita: infra says maintenance will start at 22:25 but it's low-risk. Still prefer no concurrent changes.

 tess: agreed. We'll keep the rollout paused. If metrics stabilize → plan to reattempt bump after quiet window ends + 10m green.

 kate: decision: HOLD -> pin eu-west, pause global rollout, monitor 15m. :thumbsup: 

 maya: I'll post an update at +10m and +15m with screenshots.

 tess: thx all. If rollback needed, we'll follow runbook and coordinate a global rollback. For now ops +1 hold. :lock: 

 omar: noted. keeping oncall looped.

 maya: 6362469150 — 10m snapshot attached (link). No further increase in 5xx after pin. waiting 5 more.

 kate: green enough to unpause later? we'll reconvene at 22:40 UTC.

 tess: logging this thread into the rollout ticket.
